title: The Hidden Radio ~ Product Review ~ MyBanana
description:
Sometimes the best ideas are the simplest. More @ www.MyBanana.com/HiddenRadio

Simple and intuitive to use, the Hidden Radio Bluetooth Speaker offers incredible sound whilst seamlessly fitting into any environment. With Bluetooth, wired and FM radio functionality, it really covers everyone's needs.

Twist to hear. It's that easy. And the more you twist, the louder it gets.

Take it anywhere. With a 30+ hour battery life, the Hidden Radio Bluetooth Speaker really is your ultimate travel buddy - you don't even need to remember the wires with its Bluetooth capability.

Seamlessly switch. Why not have a few of these beauties around your home? You can simply walk between them, letting the Bluetooth do the work, and enjoy crystal clear, 80dB sound wherever you go.

What's not to like?

Compatible with all iPhones, all iPads, iPod Touches, Macbooks and any Bluetooth enabled device.

Also compatible with any audio device via the 3.5mm audio jack and cable provided (wired).
